content: By extrapolating algorithms between paradigms, one can go beyond crafting new algorithms from scratch as in most existing studies, which often requires deep expertise and yields unique solutions in a dedicated context. Instead, innovation becomes easier by importing rich ideas from other paradigms, and is repeatable as a new algorithm can be methodically extrapolated to multiple different contexts.
